title: PR #42: fix(node): use canonical chain id in startup log
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

Fixes the canonical atc-node startup path to log NUMERIC_CHAIN_ID, which is the imported canonical chain identity. The previous DEFAULT_CHAIN_ID reference is undefined and can break compilation of the node binary.

This is a targeted compile/runtime integration fix; no consensus semantics are changed.
